name: Seminarium
description:
Seminarium

The bank is ported from Tides of War mod (by MDT) and rebalanced.

Value: 3500
Rarity: 80

Size 1: guarded by 5x4 Crusaders, gives 1 Paladin (15%)
Size 2: guarded by 5x8 Crusaders, gives 2 Paladins (35%)
Size 3: guarded by 5x12 Crusaders, gives 3 Paladins (35%)
Size 4: guarded by 5x16 Crusaders, gives 4 Paladins (15%)

If HotA mod is enabled, Seminarium substitutes Experimental Shop.
